steps.en: Staff opens the notice search page, all or outstanding
steps.id: Staff membuka halaman cari notice, semua atau outstanding

steps.en: Staff searches by notice number or vehicle number
steps.id: Staff mencari berdasarkan nomor notice atau nomor kendaraan

steps.en: Staff searches by offence date range
steps.id: Staff mencari berdasarkan rentang tanggal offence

steps.en: Staff searches by summons number or warrant number
steps.id: Staff mencari berdasarkan nomor summons atau warrant
steps.why_en: The fields are on screen, but no data source exists behind them, so these searches cannot return real results.
steps.why_id: Field-nya ada di layar, tetapi tidak ada sumber data di belakangnya, jadi pencarian ini tidak bisa memberi hasil nyata.

steps.en: Staff filters by notice type, stage, payment status and more
steps.id: Staff memfilter berdasarkan jenis notice, stage, status bayar, dan lainnya

steps.en: Drop-down choices are filled from the system's reference data
steps.id: Pilihan drop-down diisi dari data referensi sistem

steps.en: Search results are shown in a list that staff can browse
steps.id: Hasil pencarian tampil di tabel yang bisa di-browse staff

steps.why_en: Download works, but result sets above 1000 notices are refused.
steps.why_id: Unduhan berfungsi, tetapi hasil di atas 1000 notice ditolak.
